answer: Give every agent a single harbor berth that can host only one live rendezvous at a time: at unpredictable moments a nebula beacon calls each berth, and the agent must answer with a fresh jade proof derived from that beacon within seconds. One operator cannot answer beacons for many berths at once, so each clone needs its own always-on operator while its reward stays fixed per berth. Missed beacons sink the berth, so farming multiplies live-attention cost without multiplying income.
